claim: Interleukin 25 (IL-25) is a major 'alarmin' cytokine capable of initiating and amplifying the type 2 immune response to helminth parasites.
source: Interleukin 25 (IL-25) is a major 'alarmin' cytokine, capable of initiating and amplifying the type immune response to helminth parasites.
evidence: This is a general statement in the abstract that draws from established scientific understanding of IL-25 function.

claim: The role of IL-25 in the later effector phase of clearing chronic helminth infection remains unclear.
source: However, its role in the later effector phase of clearing chronic infection remains unclear.
evidence: This statement identifies a gap in knowledge, representing the motivation for the study.

claim: Heligmosomoides polygyrus establishes long-term infections in susceptible C57BL/6 mice.
source: The helminth Heligmosomoides polygyrus establishes long-term infections in susceptible C57BL/6 mice, but is slowly expelled in BALB/c mice from day 14 onwards.
evidence: This is a known characteristic of H. polygyrus infection in different mouse strains.

claim: Heligmosomoides polygyrus is slowly expelled in BALB/c mice from day 14 onwards.
source: The helminth Heligmosomoides polygyrus establishes long-term infections in susceptible C57BL/6 mice, but is slowly expelled in BALB/c mice from day 14 onwards.
evidence: This is a known characteristic of H. polygyrus infection in different mouse strains.

claim: IL-25R (Il17rb)-deficient BALB/c mice were unable to expel H. polygyrus parasites despite type 2 immune activation comparable to wild-type.
source: We noted that IL-25R (Il17rb)-deficient BALB/c mice were unable to expel parasites despite type 2 immune activation comparable to the wild-type.
evidence: This is a primary finding of the study supported by experimental data shown in Figure 1.

claim: IL-25 administered late in infection (days 14–17) drove immunity in C57BL/6 mice.
source: We then established that in C57BL/6 mice, IL-25 adminstered late in infection (days 14–17) drove immunity.
evidence: This is a primary finding supported by experimental data shown in Figure 4.

claim: The combination of IL-25 and IL-4 delivered to Rag1-deficient mice resulted in near complete expulsion of H. polygyrus.
source: Moreover, when IL-25 and IL-4 were delivered to Rag1-deficient mice, the combination resulted in near complete expulsion of the parasite, even following administration of an anti-CD90 antibody to deplete innate lymphoid cells (ILCs).
evidence: This is a primary finding supported by experimental data shown in Figure 3.

claim: Near complete expulsion of H. polygyrus occurred in Rag1-deficient mice treated with IL-25 and IL-4 even after anti-CD90 antibody depletion of innate lymphoid cells.

claim: Effective anti-helminth immunity during chronic infection requires an innate effector cell population that is synergistically activated by the combination of IL-4Rα and IL-25R signaling.
source: Hence, effective anti-helminth immunity during chronic infection requires an innate effector cell population that is synergistically activated by the combination of IL-4Rα and IL-25R signaling.
